mapper.sql: select id, title, description, cover_image, author, category_id, view_count, video_count, sort_order, status, created_at, updated_at from collections
mapper.select:
and title like concat('%', #{title}, '%') and author like concat('%', #{author}, '%') and FIND_IN_SET(#{categoryId}, category_id) and status = #{status}
order by sort_order desc, created_at desc

mapper.select: select v.*, vc.sort_order as sortOrder from videos v inner join video_collections vc on v.id = vc.video_id where vc.collection_id = #{collectionId} order by vc.sort_order asc, vc.created_at asc

select v.* from videos v where v.status = 1 and v.id not in ( select vc.video_id from video_collections vc where vc.collection_id = #{collectionId} )
and v.title like concat('%', #{video.title}, '%')
and v.author like concat('%', #{video.author}, '%')
and v.id in ( select vctr.video_id from video_category_tag_relations vctr where vctr.category_id = #{video.categoryId} and vctr.relation_type = 1 )
order by v.created_at desc

select c.* from categories c where c.id in ( select SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(col.category_id, ',', numbers.n), ',', -1) as category_id from collections col cross join ( select 1 n union all select 2 union all select 3 union all select 4 union all select 5 union all select 6 union all select 7 union all select 8 union all select 9 union all select 10 ) numbers where col.id = #{collectionId} and CHAR_LENGTH(col.category_id) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(col.category_id, ',', '')) >= numbers.n - 1 ) and c.status = 1 order by c.sort_order desc
mapper.update: update collections set view_count = view_count + #{increment}, updated_at = now() where id = #{collectionId}
mapper.select: select id, name, description, sort_order, status, is_collection, created_at, updated_at from categories where status = 1 and is_collection = 1 order by sort_order desc, created_at desc
